about.heading: Connecting Ground Realities with Academic Innovation
about.sub: A closed, accountable problem-solving architecture initiated for the people of Jharkhand.
about.missionText: Jharkhand has thousands of local problems that already have technical answers sitting in university departments — and thousands of students who need real problems to work on. SamadhanSetu is the bridge (Setu) between the two, with the district administration in the middle to keep the network vetted and accountable.
about.forWhomSub: SamadhanSetu unites five key stakeholders into a unified digital workflow:
about.citizensDesc: Voicing localized infrastructure, civic, environmental, and public service problems.
about.govtDesc: District administration reviewing, validating, and allocating challenges to ensure public accountability.
about.universitiesDesc: Engineering faculties and academic laboratories adopting real problems for research.
about.studentsDesc: Aspiring innovators building functional hardware and software prototypes for capstone credits.
about.industryDesc: Corporate and manufacturing entities contributing technology, mentorship, and scaling support.
about.moneyText: Industry funding commitments are recorded for transparency and reporting only. The actual transfer of funds happens through existing government and institutional channels — SamadhanSetu never processes payments.
about.networkText: This is not an open marketplace. Universities and industry partners cannot pick problems on their own. Every problem is reviewed by a government administrator, who decides which institutions it should go to. Institutional accounts are activated only after manual verification.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about the SamadhanSetu problem-solving ecosystem.
faq.q1: How do I report a problem?
faq.a1: Register or log in as a Citizen, verify your email, and go to your dashboard. Provide a clear title, description, location, and optional evidence. The issue will be automatically classified and submitted for administrative review.
faq.a2: Verified universities, engineering institutions, and student research teams adopt problems routed to them by administrators. Industry partners collaborate with universities to assist in technical scaling and manufacturing.
faq.a3: District administrators review every submitted problem to confirm legitimacy, eliminate duplicates, verify jurisdiction, and allocate the challenge to the most suitable academic institution.
faq.a4: Yes. Once submitted, citizens can monitor live progress badges ('Pending Verification', 'Under Review', 'Adopted by University', 'In Progress', 'Solved') directly from their Citizen Dashboard.
faq.a5: No. SamadhanSetu never processes financial transactions. Any grant allocations or industry funding commitments are conducted through established government, banking, or university financial frameworks outside this platform.
faq.a6: Universities create an institutional account that undergoes manual verification by state authorities. Once verified, researchers can browse allocated problems, adopt them as capstone or R&D initiatives, and submit milestone updates.
faq.a7: Industries register as corporate partners to mentor student teams, provide specialized equipment, offer testing facilities, and support real-world pilot deployments for approved university prototypes.
